newsitem.title: UK: Eagle Star unveils plastic car insurance cards.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Star unveils plastic car insurance cards.

text.p: UK motor insurer Eagle Star Direct, part of the tobacco and financial services group B.A.T industries, introduced wallet-sized plastic insurance certificates on Thursday to replace traditional paper ones.
The cards hold all the statutory insurance information as well as quick reference information such as the number to telephone when reporting claims.
"Our research shows that people find the usual paper certificate inconvenient, and they often don't know where to look for it when they need it," said personal lines managing director Roger Townsend.
"By offering our customers a plastic certificate they can keep in their wallets, we are responding to our customers' needs for products which are easier to understand and easier to use," he added.

Eagle Star said its research showed that 79 percent of motorists shown the card said it would make life easier for them as it would help them make a claim if the had an accident or their car was stolen.

Most said they kept their paper certificates at home, of which 17 percent said they would have difficulty finding it. Another 56 percent said they would have no idea which number to call when making a claim.
